invariants: Expression choice codes (long_cash, long_lever, short_via_future, close_leg) are stored in expression_reason_code and never used as reason_code.
Actual rejection reason_code is selected from reject_reason, risk_reason, reason, broker_submission_status, or non-expression reason_code (or sell_without_holdings).
Pre-broker rejections set submitted_to_broker=false and order_status='not_submitted'.

If producer evidence is omitted (no non-expression reason or missing required/available/holding_quantity/requested_quantity), reason_code='reason_not_recorded' is retained when the reason is absent and missing_evidence lists the omitted fields.

One rejection cause at risk_evaluation (status='rejected', rejected_stage='risk_evaluation', current_stage='risk_evaluation') with reason_code, reason_detail, source_event_id, expression_reason_code, and missing_evidence when applicable.
Order not submitted on order_submission (stages.order_submission.status='not_submitted', order_status='not_submitted', submitted_to_broker=false) with no duplicate failure status or reason.

Timeline item for pre-broker risk rejection is normalized to stage='risk_evaluation', stage_status='rejected', status='rejected', order_status='not_submitted', submitted_to_broker=false, preserving source_event_id, reason_code, reason_detail, expression_reason_code, and missing_evidence.

Booking reconciliation runs for journeys whose committed position snapshot carries broker submission (submitted_to_broker=true) or any booking comparison field (position_quantity_before, position_quantity_after, cash_before, cash_after, fill_quantity, fill_price, broker_order_id); legacy in-process non-broker snapshots without booking comparison fields reconcile as before.

Completed numeric trade-specific comparisons (broker_fill_qty, broker_fill_price, position_change, committed_snapshot_position, cash_change, committed_snapshot_cash) carry check, status, expected, actual, difference, and delta.
When expected or actual is None on a fill journey, the check is marked status='unverified' with difference=null, delta=null, and missing_evidence=['expected'|'actual'].
Accounting variance codes (cash_variance, position_variance, broker_fill_mismatch, broker_record_missing) are emitted only when a trade-specific comparison completed and failed.
If a fill journey has unverified checks and no proven discrepancy, it emits reconciliation_evidence_incomplete.
Runtime health and broker read errors honor the 60-minute defer window before stamping runtime_unhealthy_at_reconciliation or broker_unavailable_at_reconciliation.

accounting_variance.condition: At least one trade-specific check independently completed with both expected and actual present, failed beyond tolerance (1e-6), and has no conflicting supplied delta/difference/status on that check, populating discrepancies with check, expected, actual, delta, and difference. Any unrelated check that lacks inputs or has conflicting evidence is downgraded to status='unverified' and retained in missing_evidence without clearing proven discrepancies.

runtime_health.sql_filter: Excluded from attention=recon_mismatch and attention=attention in SQL whether signaled by reason_code (runtime_unhealthy_at_reconciliation or reconciliation_deferred_runtime_unhealthy) or inferred from reason_detail runtime health checks.

broker_unavailable.sql_filter: Excluded from attention=recon_mismatch and attention=attention in SQL whether signaled by reason_code (broker_unavailable_at_reconciliation or reconciliation_deferred_broker_unavailable) or inferred from reason_detail broker_record status=unavailable.

unverified_evidence.condition: Reconciliation failed without a completed trade-specific discrepancy or with conflicting delta/difference/status evidence, and without runtime_health or broker_unavailable evidence; missing_evidence explicitly identifies the missing or conflicting data.
